posts.name: Ronway

Those images are quite exciting! Seeing that Sentinels of the Multiverse was still being demoed, even without >G there is exciting! Plus all those games. They nearly stacked up to my shoulder. So beautiful! I still popped in for a game as well, i'm not addicted or anything...
